dedupe_keys.name: vuelo fotogrametrico del ano 2006 del puerto de valencia

description: Vuelo fotogramétrico del año 2006 del Puerto de València is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Colour (RGB) photogrammetric flight scanned of the Port of València at a scale of 1:22.000, taken on 24/06/2006 using a Wild 15/4 UAG-S camera. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Photogrammetric flight of the Port of València corresponding to the year 2006" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Port of València, Fotograma, Institut Cartogràfic Valencià, 2006, Photogrammetric flight, Comunitat Valenciana. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
